options.name: command
options.description: The command to execute. Currently only C(migrate) is supported.

options.name: config
options.description: Path to the Forgejo configuration file (C(--config)).

options.name: parameters
options.description: Additional command-line parameters passed to C(forgejo migrate). This list is appended verbatim.

options.name: working_dir
options.description: Path to the Forgejo working directory (C(--work-path)). Typically the home directory of the Forgejo service user.
